rollups.text: The user reported collecting 15 autographed baseballs on 2023-07-11, after starting the collection about three months earlier, and later said the sports memorabilia collection had grown to 20 autographed baseballs by 2023-12-30. Around 2023-07-04, the user added a signed Mike Trout baseball. The count increased by five between the reported totals; the records do not establish whether the Mike Trout ball was included in either count.

On 2023-06-25, the user said three cucumber plants were producing a large harvest and that they were harvesting cucumbers daily. They explored cucumber recipes and storage, then said they were excited to try a dill-pickle recipe to preserve some of the harvest and asked how to scale it down for a few jars. They also asked whether table salt could replace kosher salt; the assistant said it could, with an adjustment for density and possible effects from additives. No completed batch of pickles was reported.

The user started planning a garden layout on 2023-01-15, according to a gardening app. Around 2023-06-10, they planted peas and built a trellis; on 2023-06-25, they reported a large daily cucumber harvest from three plants; and on 2023-07-10, they said they had planted marigolds with their tomatoes. The user finds the gardening app useful for tracking progress, reminders, notes, photos, and weather forecasts for planning tasks. The records span about 176 days from initial layout planning to the latest dated planting update.

On 2023-11-28, the user said they had resumed selling handmade candles and soaps at local markets and had made about $250 at a Saturday farmers’ market a few weeks earlier. They were considering applying to a larger convention-center craft fair and were concerned about competition. They liked demonstrating products and offering samples, considered sharing a booth and cross-promoting with a jewelry maker they had met, and chose a promotion of 10% off purchases of $50 or more plus a free travel-sized candle with a soap-and-lotion set. They planned to promote the offer through social media, email, and booth signage. They also considered a loyalty program but had not chosen its structure. No craft-fair application, booth partnership, or loyalty program outcome was reported.

On 2023-12-30, the user said they planned to pick up their script for a community theater production of Les Misérables and that they had the role of Éponine, with many lines to learn. They asked about rehearsal scheduling and received memorization suggestions. They planned to write a program bio, considered mentioning a stage-combat workshop attended in November 2023 and an upcoming dialect-coaching workshop, and said a costume fitting was coming up. They planned to discuss costume and prop ideas with the costume designer and director and review the script. The records do not confirm the fitting, rehearsals, or performance dates.

On 2023-12-30, the user said they had recently resumed water-based activities and wanted a better waterproof bag for kayaking gear. On December 30–31, 2023, they kayaked with friends on Tomales Bay, rented kayaks from Blue Waters Kayaking, and paddled to Hog Island; they described the trip as a blast. They were also considering a camping trip and a return to Big Sur, where they had previously camped with friends and hiked to McWay Falls. For a future Big Sur outing, they chose the Pine Ridge Trail to Sykes Camp, expecting a five-to-six-hour hike and planning portable, high-energy snacks; they were considering a more comfortable, better-ventilated backpack. No future Big Sur trip was confirmed.
rollups.topic: Kayaking and planned Big Sur hike

rollups.text: On 2023-12-18, the user hosted a large playoff get-together with extra chairs and a coffee table in a corner; the group ordered pizza and wings, and the user said the setup worked well. By 2024-01-01, the user had rearranged the living room and mounted a new 55-inch TV. They were considering another casual game-day gathering for about the same number of guests, with cozy corners, pillows, blankets, snacks, and finger foods. They were unsure whether their basic 2.1-channel sound system would provide clear sound for a large group and were considering a soundbar or home-theater upgrade. No second gathering or audio upgrade was confirmed.

On 2023-07-10, the user said they had installed a 1TB hard drive bought from Amazon for $60 and planned to upgrade laptop RAM from 8GB to 16GB, particularly for video editing. They decided to upgrade to an SSD, clone the existing hard drive, and use the SSD as the primary drive; completion was not confirmed. They also considered a Western Digital My Passport 2TB external drive for about $100 for backups, but did not confirm a purchase. They decided to buy a $30 Etsy laptop sleeve for protection and style. The dated records cover the storage and accessory plans on 2023-07-10.

The user said they had been listening to educational podcasts during their daily commute by 2023-12-09, naming How I Built This and Stuff You Should Know. On 2023-11-07, they described the morning commute as about 30 minutes, said they were not a morning person, and reported that engaging audiobooks or podcasts helped them stay focused and alert. They planned to try a mix of formats and experiment with playback speed and sleep timers. On 2023-12-09, they also said they had recently finished Sapiens and wanted more history and anthropology content. The records document these interests and plans, not the results of the experiments.

The user has a recurring interest in collecting: by 2023-07-11, they had collected autographed baseballs for about three months and had 15, including a signed Mike Trout ball obtained around 2023-07-04; by 2023-12-30, they reported 20 autographed baseballs. On 2023-12-30, they also reported acquiring a 1943 Lincoln Wheat Cent with a copper-planchet error and asked about learning more about error coins; an earlier record shows interest in error-coin collecting on 2023-07-11. The user owns a vintage Leica camera and was considering a new lens on 2023-12-30; on 2023-07-11, they had considered selling the Leica and other vintage cameras. The user also has a vinyl-record collection: on 2023-07-11, they considered adding international pressings and rare Japanese records, and on 2023-12-30, they considered selling some records to make space.
